lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible across the mid-flank. Centroids follow a semi-rectilinear grid, with primary clusters located posterior to the gill slits and superior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, particularly evident in the mid-section, creating a visible lattice or grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the longitudinal axis. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and localized shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin, visible in the lower quadrant, exhibits a high density of smaller, lower-luminance spots compared to the macro-spots on the lateral flank.
